_comment: DEEP CONTENT, one source for the product page and the agents. The page renders these between HTML markers (next/build-product-pages.py explainers_html) and SAIKIMI.explore() walks the same tree in the chat, so the two can never drift. The model may CHOOSE and PHRASE items from here; it may never author a product fact. Items marked answerOnly are never offered as a chip — they exist so the agent can answer a direct question honestly instead of overclaiming.

machines_family.name: The Machine
machines_family._nameNote: What to call it on the page and in the chat. The catalog's own name for this entry is "Stagwell's Machines (family frame)", which is a routing label, not something to say to a visitor.
machines_family.source: The Machine: EXTERNAL demo deck (the three differentiators, stated twice), the Machine Use Case Library, and the seller playbook's does-NOT-do table (client, 2026-09-17). Nothing here names a client, a price, a roadmap date or a person.

differentiators.title: An open architecture
differentiators.line: Built API-first, so it adapts at every layer, and platform-agnostic across models, cloud providers and front-end applications. It connects to your stack rather than asking you to replace it.

differentiators.title: Works where you work
differentiators.line: Beyond The Machine's own interface, Mini-Machines are custom plugins that let teams use its intelligence — and send information back to it — inside Figma, Slack, Adobe, Microsoft Teams and Workfront.

differentiators.title: A unified intelligence layer
differentiators.line: Custom-trained to ingest, interpret and act on large volumes of private, secure signals — your data, world knowledge, Stagwell's proprietary sources and trusted third parties.

items.name: Audience & persona research
items.line: Replaces weeks of fragmented desk research with continuously refreshed, evidence-grounded segments and personas tied to the actual brand objective.

items.name: Strategy & campaign architecture
items.line: Turns business goals plus audience truth into a coherent architecture — objective, audience, message hierarchy, channel role, KPI framework — with options and trade-offs in hours instead of weeks.

items.name: Measurement design & experiment set-up
items.line: Designs measurement up front: the right KPI framework, attribution method and clean experiments, so campaigns are provable rather than merely reportable.

items.name: Media planning & budget allocation
items.line: Builds and continuously re-optimises channel mix, budget allocation and flighting grounded in measurement rather than platform self-reporting.

items.name: Creative briefing
items.line: Produces sharp, complete, on-strategy briefs that inherit audience, brand and objective context automatically — closing the vague-brief, wrong-work, redo loop.

items.name: Ideation, concepting & storyboarding
items.line: Moves from approved brief to a slate of distinct, on-brand, channel-feasible concepts, checked against brand and channel reality before money is spent.

items.name: Creative & content scaling
items.line: Takes an approved hero asset and produces the full matrix of platform, format, dimension and locale variants — correctly resized, cropped, tagged and compliant.

items.name: Localisation & transcreation
items.line: Adapts campaigns across markets and languages with cultural and regulatory fidelity, reusing approved layouts and respecting per-market claims.

items.name: Compliance checks
items.line: Shifts compliance to the point of creation: every asset and line of copy checked against brand guardrails, platform ad policy and regulatory rules before it ships, with an auditable trail.

items.name: Trafficking, handoff & QA
items.line: Automates the brittle manual handoff from approved creative to live media — placements, tags, naming and trafficking sheets correct the first time.

items.name: Mid-flight optimisation & DCO
items.line: Watches live performance, diagnoses why something is moving and recommends or executes the next best action, compressing the signal-to-change loop from weeks to near real-time.

items.name: Campaign reporting & narrative
items.line: Turns fragmented platform and measurement data into a single narrated performance story per stakeholder, with every number grounded in its source.

items.name: Learning & pattern recognition
items.line: Captures what worked, where and why into a living, queryable learnings library — turning the post-campaign retrospective into compounding institutional memory.

items.name: New business & RFP response
items.line: Assembles tailored, on-strategy responses from the organisation's best prior work, credentials and capabilities — stronger pitches for far less senior time.

items.name: Social listening & community
items.line: Continuously monitors brand, category and competitor conversation, surfaces risk, trend and opportunity, and routes the right action in time to matter.

connectsTo.title: Adobe, Figma and your reporting suites
connectsTo.line: Connects to them and makes their outputs smarter by cross-referencing the wider knowledge base.

connectsTo.title: Your content supply chain
connectsTo.line: Part of the factory: it orchestrates across the supply chain rather than replacing it.

connectsTo.title: Your measurement platforms
connectsTo.line: Combines disparate platforms to deliver better strategic measurement and recommendations.

connectsTo.title: Flighting and distribution
connectsTo.line: Connects to the platforms that do it, so approved work reaches live media without a manual rebuild.

notDo.claim: Replace Adobe, Figma, your reporting suites or other software.
notDo.instead: It connects to them and makes their outputs smarter by cross-referencing the wider knowledge base.

notDo.claim: Generate content as a standalone capability.
notDo.instead: It supports briefing and connects to the generation tools in your content supply chain.
It is part of the factory — it connects to and orchestrates across the supply chain.
keywords: is it a content supply chain

notDo.claim: Be an owned measurement or reporting platform.
notDo.instead: It combines disparate platforms to deliver better strategic measurement and recommendations.

notDo.claim: Do asset flighting and distribution itself.
notDo.instead: It connects to the platforms that do.
Image generation is live and well integrated; voice is on the roadmap, and video runs through partners rather than natively.

notDo.claim: Replace human judgement on taste or breakthrough creative.
notDo.instead: It is strong at matching and governance — on-brand or off-brand, pass or fail. Greenfield taste stays a human craft; it compresses the slow cycles so creative leaders spend their time where judgement matters.
